verses.sloka: प्रभातायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् पृथु वृक्षा महा यशाः ।उवाच रामः सौमित्रिम् लक्ष्मणम् शुभ लक्षणम् ॥२-५२-१॥
verses.transliteration: prabhātāyām tu śarvaryām pṛthu vṛkṣā mahā yaśāḥ ।uvāca rāmaḥ saumitrim lakṣmaṇam śubha lakṣaṇam ॥2-52-1॥

translations.english: As the night advanced towards dawn, broadchested Rama of great renown said to Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, who had auspicious marks on his body:

verses.sloka: भास्कर उदय कालो अयम् गता भगवती निशा ।असौ सुकृष्णो विहगः कोकिलः तात कूजति ॥२-५२-२॥
verses.transliteration: bhāskara udaya kālo ayam gatā bhagavatī niśā ।asau sukṛṣṇo vihagaḥ kokilaḥ tāta kūjati ॥2-52-2॥

translations.english: O dear Lakshmana the holy night is over and it is time for sunrise. The deep dark bird, the cuckoo is singing.
translations.hindi: है लक्षंमण ! तुम्हारे सोने के लिए यह बिछौना तैयार है । इस पर हे राजकुमार ! तुम सुखपूवक बिश्राम करो

verses.sloka: बर्हिणानाम् च निर्घोषः श्रूयते नदताम् वने ।तराम जाह्नवीम् सौम्य शीघ्रगाम् सागरम् गमाम् ॥२-५२-३॥
verses.transliteration: barhiṇānām ca nirghoṣaḥ śrūyate nadatām vane ।tarāma jāhnavīm saumya śīghragām sāgaram gamām ॥2-52-3॥

translations.english: Listen to the screams of the peacocks in the forest. The Ganga is flowing fast to merge in the sea. We need to cross it.
translations.hindi: हम लोग, जो बन में रहा करते हैं, कष्ट सहने के आदी हैं आर तुम सदा सुख भोगते रहे हो, अतः तुमको सुख मिलना उचित है । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की रखवाली के लिए हम लोग रात भर जागते रहेंगे । अतः तुम लेट रहो और सोओ

verses.sloka: विज्ञाय रामस्य वचः सौमित्रिर् मित्र नन्दनः ।गुहम् आमन्त्र्य सूतम् च सो अतिष्ठद् भ्रातुर् अग्रतः ॥२-५२-४॥
verses.transliteration: vijñāya rāmasya vacaḥ saumitrir mitra nandanaḥ ।guham āmantrya sūtam ca so atiṣṭhad bhrātur agrataḥ ॥2-52-4॥

translations.english: In response to Rama's desire, Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, one who brings joy to his friends, called Guha and the charioteer (Sumantra) and stood before his brother.
translations.hindi: क ( कदाचित्‌ लक्ष्मण को यह्‌ पोर, हो कि गुह रात भर नः जागेगा ओर लक्ष्मण को सुलाने को वह्‌ बात कहता है इस पर गुह कहता है ) इस संसार में. श्रीरामचन्द्र से बढ़कर सेरा प्यारा | angotri In itiati Sy >». है] Sy 4 १, रन पनन न लक पय दूसरा कोई नहीं है । यह बात मैं सत्य की शपथ खा कर तुमसे सत्य ही सत्य कहता हूँ

verses.sloka: स तु रामस्य वचनम् निशम्य प्रतिगृह्य च ।स्थपतिस्तूर्णमाहुय सचिवानिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-५॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu rāmasya vacanam niśamya pratigṛhya ca ।sthapatistūrṇamāhuya sacivānidamabravīt ॥2-52-5॥

translations.english: Having heard and accepted Rama's proposal, the king of the nisadas called his ministers at once and said:
translations.hindi: क्योंकि इन्हीं ( श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ) की प्रसन्नता से मैं बड़ा यश, धर्मे, बहुत सा धन और काम चाहता हुँ ( अथीत्‌ इनके. प्रसन्न होने से मुझे अर्थ, धम, काम, मोक्ष सभी कुछ मिल सकता है, अतः मैं रात भर जाग कर और रखबाली कर इनको प्रसन्नः रखू गा )

verses.sloka: अस्य वाहनसम्युक्ताम् कर्णग्राहवतीम् शुभाम् ।सुप्रताराम् दृढाम् तीर्खे शीग्रम् नावमुपाहर ॥२-५२-६॥
verses.transliteration: asya vāhanasamyuktām karṇagrāhavatīm śubhām ।supratārām dṛḍhām tīrkhe śīgram nāvamupāhara ॥2-52-6॥

translations.english: Get quickly to the sacred bank (of Ganga) a strong, auspicious boat equipped with rowing rods and helmsmen who can help cross the river with ease
translations.hindi: अतः में हाथ में धनुष लेकर अपने परिबार के लोगों के साथ सीता सहित सोए हुए अपने प्रिय मित्र श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की हृर तरह से रखवाली करू गा

verses.sloka: तम् निशम्य समादेशम् गुहामात्यगणो महान् ।उपोह्य रुचिराम् नावम् गुहाय प्रत्यवेदयत् ॥२-५२-७॥
verses.transliteration: tam niśamya samādeśam guhāmātyagaṇo mahān ।upohya rucirām nāvam guhāya pratyavedayat ॥2-52-7॥

translations.english: The ministers heard the orders, soon brought a beautiful boat and informed Guha (that his orders have been carried out).
translations.hindi: इस बन में भेरा बिना जाना हुआ कुछ भी नहीं है ( अथात्‌. मुझे इस बन का रत्ती-रत्ती हाल मालुम है। ) क्योंकि में तो इस बन में सदा बिचरा ही करता हुँ । यदि चतुरङ्गिणी सेना भी मेरे ऊपर आक्रमण करे, तो में इस बन का जानकार होने के कारण , उसका भी सामना करने को समथ हुँ

verses.sloka: ततः सप्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा गुहो राघवमब्रवीत् ।उपस्थितेयम् नौर्देव भूयः किम् करवाणि ते ॥२-५२-८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saprāñjalirbhūtvā guho rāghavamabravīt ।upasthiteyam naurdeva bhūyaḥ kim karavāṇi te ॥2-52-8॥

translations.english: Then Guha with folded palms said to Rama: O king, the boat ready. Tell me what else can I do for you.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे- प्रियतमम्‌ | यह सुन, लदमण जी ने गुह से कहा, हे पुण्यात्मन्‌ ! तुम्हारी रखवाली का तो हमें पूरा भरोसा है । मुझे डर किसी बात का नहीं है, किन्तु अपने कत्तेव्यपालन का मुझे पूरा ध्यान है

verses.sloka: तवामरसुतप्रख्य तर्तुम् सागरगाम् नदीम् ।नौरियम् पुरुषव्याग्र! ताम् त्वमारोह सुव्रत! ॥२-५२-९॥
verses.transliteration: tavāmarasutaprakhya tartum sāgaragām nadīm ।nauriyam puruṣavyāgra! tām tvamāroha suvrata! ॥2-52-9॥

translations.english: O best among men, renowned like a god's son and constantly engaged in vows, here is the boat for you to cross the Ganga flowing into the sea. Do board it.

verses.sloka: अथोवाच महातेजा रामो गुहमिदम् वचः ।कृतकामोऽस्मि भवता शीघ्रमारोप्यतामिति ॥२-५२-१०॥
verses.transliteration: athovāca mahātejā rāmo guhamidam vacaḥ ।kṛtakāmo'smi bhavatā śīghramāropyatāmiti ॥2-52-10॥

translations.english: Thereafter the radiant Rama said to Guha, You have fulfilled my desire. Keep all our belongings in the boat.
translations.hindi: युद्ध में जिन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का सब देवता और असुर मिल कर भी सामना नहीं कर सकते, देखो, आज वे ही सीता सहित 'घासफूस के ऊपर सो रहे हैं

verses.sloka: ततः कलापान् सम्नह्य खड्गौ बद्ध्वा च धन्विनौ ।जग्मतुर् येन तौ गन्गाम् सीतया सह राघवौ ॥२-५२-११॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kalāpān samnahya khaḍgau baddhvā ca dhanvinau ।jagmatur yena tau gangām sītayā saha rāghavau ॥2-52-11॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana then put on their quivers, fastened their swords and holding their bows went towards Ganga along with Sita.
translations.hindi: अनेक जप, तप ओर यज्ञानुष्ठान के बाद महाराज के उन जैसे लक्षणों बाले यही तो एक प्रिय पुत्र हुए हैं

verses.sloka: रामम् एव तु धर्मज्ञम् उपगम्य विनीतवत् ।किम् अहम् करवाणि इति सूतः प्रान्जलिर् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-१२॥
verses.transliteration: rāmam eva tu dharmajñam upagamya vinītavat ।kim aham karavāṇi iti sūtaḥ prānjalir abravīt ॥2-52-12॥

translations.english: The charioteer (Sumantra) approached the righteous Rama and asked him with folded hands: What can I do?

verses.sloka: ततोऽब्रवीद्दाशरथिः सुमन्त्रम् ।स्पृशन् करेणोत्तमदक्षिणेन ।सुमन्त्र शीघ्रम् पुनरेव याहि ।राज्ञः सकाशे भवचाप्रमत्तः ॥२-५२-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tato'bravīddāśarathiḥ sumantram ।spṛśan kareṇottamadakṣiṇena ।sumantra śīghram punareva yāhi ।rājñaḥ sakāśe bhavacāpramattaḥ ॥2-52-13॥

translations.english: Rama then caressed Sumantra with his right hand and said, Sumantra, go back immediately and never be inattentive in serving the king.
translations.hindi: में सममता हूँ, जो स्त्रियाँ हमारे आने पर रोती-पीटती थीं, वे अब शान्त हो गई होंगी और राजभवन में भी सन्नाटा छा. गया होगा

verses.sloka: निवर्तस्व इति उवाच एनम् एतावद्द् हि कृतम् मम ।रथम् विहाय पद्भ्याम् तु गमिष्यामि महावनम् ॥२-५२-१४॥
verses.transliteration: nivartasva iti uvāca enam etāvadd hi kṛtam mama ।ratham vihāya padbhyām tu gamiṣyāmi mahāvanam ॥2-52-14॥

translations.english: You have done enough. I shall now leave the chariot and walk into the great forest.
translations.hindi: कौसल्या, महाराज दशरथ ओर मेरी जननी सुमित्रा ये सब इस रात में जीते-जागते बच जायेंगे मुझे इसमें सन्देह है

verses.sloka: आत्मानम् तु अभ्यनुज्ञातम् अवेक्ष्य आर्तः स सारथिः ।सुमन्त्रः पुरुष व्याघ्रम् ऐक्ष्वाकम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-१५॥
verses.transliteration: ātmānam tu abhyanujñātam avekṣya ārtaḥ sa sārathiḥ ।sumantraḥ puruṣa vyāghram aikṣvākam idam abravīt ॥2-52-15॥

translations.english: Having been permitted to go, Sumantra, the distressed charioteer, said to Rama, the best among men, and a descendant of the Ikshvaku race:
translations.hindi: शत्रुघ्न का मुख देखती हुई मेरी माता तो जीती भी रहे, किन्तु यह्‌ बड़ा दुःख है कि बीरजननी कौसल्या जी बिना श्रीराम के. अवश्य शरीर त्याग देंगी

verses.sloka: न अतिक्रान्तम् इदम् लोके पुरुषेण इह केनचित् ।तव सभ्रातृ भार्यस्य वासः प्राकृतवद् वने ॥२-५२-१६॥
verses.transliteration: na atikrāntam idam loke puruṣeṇa iha kenacit ।tava sabhrātṛ bhāryasya vāsaḥ prākṛtavad vane ॥2-52-16॥

translations.english: None else in this world would be able to live in the forest as you have resolved to, like a common man, along with your brother and spouse.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी में अनुराग रखने बाले प्रजाजनों से भरी हुई . . सुख-समृद्धि वाली, लोकप्रिय अयोध्यापुरी, हाय ! महाराज के मरने के शोक से नष्ट हो जायगी

verses.sloka: न मन्ये ब्रह्म चर्ये अस्ति स्वधीते वा फल उदयः ।मार्दव आर्जवयोः वा अपि त्वाम् चेद् व्यसनम् आगतम् ॥२-५२-१७॥
verses.transliteration: na manye brahma carye asti svadhīte vā phala udayaḥ ।mārdava ārjavayoḥ vā api tvām ced vyasanam āgatam ॥2-52-17॥

translations.english: If your celibacy and your grief are the consequences of your study of the Vedic lore, your compassionate nature and simplicity of character, I think there is no use of all these (virtues).

verses.sloka: सह राघव वैदेह्या भ्रात्रा चैव वने वसन् ।त्वम् गतिम् प्राप्स्यसे वीर त्रीम्ल् लोकाम्स् तु जयन्न् इव ॥२-५२-१८॥
verses.transliteration: saha rāghava vaidehyā bhrātrā caiva vane vasan ।tvam gatim prāpsyase vīra trīml lokāms tu jayann iva ॥2-52-18॥

translations.english: Valiant scion of the Raghus dwelling in the forest along with Vaidehi (Sita) and brother Lakshmana you will attain the status as if you have won the three worlds.
translations.hindi: हाराज के मरते ही महारानी कौसल्या भी मर जायगी और 'कोसल्या के बाद मेरी माता भी नाश को प्राप्त होगी

verses.sloka: वयम् खलु हता राम ये तया अपि उपवन्चिताः ।कैकेय्या वशम् एष्यामः पापाया दुह्ख भागिनः ॥२-५२-१९॥
verses.transliteration: vayam khalu hatā rāma ye tayā api upavancitāḥ ।kaikeyyā vaśam eṣyāmaḥ pāpāyā duhkha bhāginaḥ ॥2-52-19॥

translations.english: Deprived of you, O Rama we will come under the control of that sinful Kaikeyi. We will suffer and die.

verses.sloka: इति ब्रुवन्न् आत्म समम् सुमन्त्रः सारथिस् तदा ।दृष्ट्वा दुर गतम् रामम् दुह्ख आर्तः रुरुदे चिरम् ॥२-५२-२०॥
verses.transliteration: iti bruvann ātma samam sumantraḥ sārathis tadā ।dṛṣṭvā dura gatam rāmam duhkha ārtaḥ rurude ciram ॥2-52-20॥

translations.english: Rama was like his (Sumantra's) own self. When Sumantra, the charioteer, saw that Rama was preparing to go afar for a long time, he started weeping aloud in deep distress.
translations.hindi: अब तो भाग्यवान्‌ वही है, जो महाराज के पास उनके अंत समय में उपस्थित रह कर, उनके सब ओऔषध्वे देहिक कृत्य करेगा !

verses.sloka: ततः तु विगते बाष्पे सूतम् स्पृष्ट उदकम् शुचिम् ।रामः तु मधुरम् वाक्यम् पुनः पुनर् उवाच तम् ॥२-५२-२१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tu vigate bāṣpe sūtam spṛṣṭa udakam śucim ।rāmaḥ tu madhuram vākyam punaḥ punar uvāca tam ॥2-52-21॥

translations.english: After the flow of tears ceased Sumantra took a sip of water and became sanctified. Then Rama addressed him with sweet words over and over again:

verses.transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām tvayā tulyam suhṛdam na upalakṣaye ।yathā daśaratho rājā mām na śocet tathā kuru ॥2-52-22॥

translations.english: I find none else like you as friendly as you are to the Ikshvaku race. So do whatever you like to see that king Dasaratha does not brood over me.
translations.hindi: जिसमें बहुत से रथ, घोड़े और हाथी मोजूद हैं. ओर जिसमें सदा तुरही बजा करती हैं ओर जहाँ सब प्रकार की सुविधाएँ हैं ओर जो हृष्टपुष्ट जनों से भरी हुई है

verses.sloka: शोक उपहत चेताः च वृद्धः च जगती पतिः ।काम भार अवसन्नः च तस्मात् एतत् ब्रवीमि ते ॥२-५२-२३॥
verses.transliteration: śoka upahata cetāḥ ca vṛddhaḥ ca jagatī patiḥ ।kāma bhāra avasannaḥ ca tasmāt etat bravīmi te ॥2-52-23॥

translations.english: I tell you this because the lord of the earth (Dasaratha), is in deep distress. He is old. And he is under the control of his passion.
translations.hindi: जो वाटिकाओं और उद्यानों से सम्पन्न है; जहाँ नित्य सामाजिक उत्सब ( विवाह, यज्ञोपवीत, कनछेदन, मूँ डन अथवा सार्वजनिक देवोत्सव आदि ) हुआ ही करते हैं, अथवा जहाँ सदा जातीय सभाएँ हुआ करती हैं । ऐसी पिता की राजधानी में बन से लौट कर कब हम प्रसन्न होते हुए घूम गे

verses.sloka: यद् यद् आज्ञापयेत् किम्चित् स महात्मा मही पतिः ।कैकेय्याः प्रिय काम अर्थम् कार्यम् तत् अविकान्क्षया ॥२-५२-२४॥
verses.transliteration: yad yad ājñāpayet kimcit sa mahātmā mahī patiḥ ।kaikeyyāḥ priya kāma artham kāryam tat avikānkṣayā ॥2-52-24॥

translations.english: To make Kaikeyi happy, do whatever little the great king Dasaratha orders you to do.

verses.sloka: एतत् अर्थम् हि राज्यानि प्रशासति नर ईश्वराः ।यद् एषाम् सर्व कृत्येषु मनो न प्रतिहन्यते ॥२-५२-२५॥
verses.transliteration: etat artham hi rājyāni praśāsati nara īśvarāḥ ।yad eṣām sarva kṛtyeṣu mano na pratihanyate ॥2-52-25॥

translations.english: The minds of kings create no hurdles in all that they want to do. That is why they rule kingdoms.

verses.sloka: यद्यथा स महा राजो न अलीकम् अधिगच्चति ।न च ताम्यति दुह्खेन सुमन्त्र कुरु तत् तथा ॥२-५२-२६॥
verses.transliteration: yadyathā sa mahā rājo na alīkam adhigaccati ।na ca tāmyati duhkhena sumantra kuru tat tathā ॥2-52-26॥

translations.english: Sumantra do things exactly in the manner the great king desires so that he does not feel sad or disappointed.

verses.sloka: अदृष्ट दुह्खम् राजानम् वृद्धम् आर्यम् जित इन्द्रियम् ।ब्रूयाः त्वम् अभिवाद्य एव मम हेतोर् इदम् वचः ॥२-५२-२७॥
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭa duhkham rājānam vṛddham āryam jita indriyam ।brūyāḥ tvam abhivādya eva mama hetor idam vacaḥ ॥2-52-27॥

translations.english: After offering your salutations, tell these words, on my behalf, to the king who is respectable, bent with age and who has conquered his senses and never experienced any sorrow before.
translations.hindi: । “> महाराजकुमार लक्ष्मण ने जो बाते माता-पितादि गुरुजनों , के स्नेह के वश, प्रजा के सम्बन्ध में गुह्‌ से कहीं, वे सब वास्तव में ठोक ही थीं । उनको सुन गुह बहुत दुःखी हुआ और उसके ' नेत्रों से आँसू बहने लगे। बहू उसी प्रकार व्यथातुर हुआ, जिस प्रकार ज्वर आने से हाथी व्यथातुर होता है

verses.sloka: न एव अहम् अनुशोचामि लक्ष्मणो न च मैथिली ।अयोध्यायाः च्युताः च इति वने वत्स्यामह इति वा (महेति!)॥२-५२-२८॥
verses.transliteration: na eva aham anuśocāmi lakṣmaṇo na ca maithilī ।ayodhyāyāḥ cyutāḥ ca iti vane vatsyāmaha iti vā (maheti!)॥2-52-28॥

translations.english: I do not regret my banishment from Ayodhya to live in the forest. Neither Lakshmana nor Sita does.

verses.sloka: चतुर् दशसु वर्षेषु निवृत्तेषु पुनः पुनः ।लक्ष्मणम् माम् च सीताम् च द्रक्ष्यसि क्षिप्रम् आगतान् ॥२-५२-२९॥
verses.transliteration: catur daśasu varṣeṣu nivṛtteṣu punaḥ punaḥ ।lakṣmaṇam mām ca sītām ca drakṣyasi kṣipram āgatān ॥2-52-29॥

translations.english: Very quickly these fourteen years will come to an end and we will return (to Ayodhya). Then you will see me, Lakshmana and Sita off and on.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा तु राजानम् मातरम् च सुमन्त्र मे ।अन्याः च देवीः सहिताः कैकेयीम् च पुनः पुनः ॥२-५२-३०॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu rājānam mātaram ca sumantra me ।anyāḥ ca devīḥ sahitāḥ kaikeyīm ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥2-52-30॥

translations.english: Having said this to the king, O Sumantra tell my mother, the other queens including Kaikeyi again and again about my wellbeing and the wellbeing of Lakshmana and Sita. Convey our respectful salutations at the feet of mother Kausalya.

verses.sloka: आरोग्यम् ब्रूहि कौसल्याम् अथ पाद अभिवन्दनम् ।सीताया मम च आर्यस्य वचनाल् लक्ष्मणस्य च ॥२-५२-३१॥
verses.transliteration: ārogyam brūhi kausalyām atha pāda abhivandanam ।sītāyā mama ca āryasya vacanāl lakṣmaṇasya ca ॥2-52-31॥

translations.english: Having said this to the king, O Sumantra tell my mother, the other queens including Kaikeyi again and again about my wellbeing and the wellbeing of Lakshmana and Sita. Convey our respectful salutations at the feet of mother Kausalya.

verses.sloka: ब्रूयाः च हि महा राजम् भरतम् क्षिप्रम् आनय ।आगतः च अपि भरतः स्थाप्यो नृप मते पदे ॥२-५२-३२॥
verses.transliteration: brūyāḥ ca hi mahā rājam bharatam kṣipram ānaya ।āgataḥ ca api bharataḥ sthāpyo nṛpa mate pade ॥2-52-32॥

translations.english: Tell the king to send for Bharata quickly, and on his arrival, he be placed in the position of the king as per his own desire.

verses.sloka: भरतम् च परिष्वज्य यौवराज्ये अभिषिच्य च ।अस्मत् सम्तापजम् दुह्खम् न त्वाम् अभिभविष्यति ॥२-५२-३३॥
verses.transliteration: bharatam ca pariṣvajya yauvarājye abhiṣicya ca ।asmat samtāpajam duhkham na tvām abhibhaviṣyati ॥2-52-33॥

translations.english: On embracing Bharata and making him the crownprince the sorrow due to our departure will not affect you.

verses.sloka: भरतः च अपि वक्तव्यो यथा राजनि वर्तसे ।तथा मातृषु वर्तेथाः सर्वास्व् एव अविशेषतः ॥२-५२-३४॥
verses.transliteration: bharataḥ ca api vaktavyo yathā rājani vartase ।tathā mātṛṣu vartethāḥ sarvāsv eva aviśeṣataḥ ॥2-52-34॥

translations.english: You should tell Bharata that just as he treats the king so should he treat all the mothers without differentiating betwen them.

verses.sloka: यथा च तव कैकेयी सुमित्रा च अविशेषतः ।तथैव देवी कौसल्या मम माता विशेषतः ॥२-५२-३५॥
verses.transliteration: yathā ca tava kaikeyī sumitrā ca aviśeṣataḥ ।tathaiva devī kausalyā mama mātā viśeṣataḥ ॥2-52-35॥

translations.english: Just as you treat Kaikeyi and Sumitra in a special manner, so should you treat Devi Kausalya, my mother.

verses.sloka: तातस्य प्रियकामेन यौवराज्यमपेक्षता ।लोकयोरुभयोः शक्यम् त्वया यत्सुखमेधितुम् ॥२-५२-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tātasya priyakāmena yauvarājyamapekṣatā ।lokayorubhayoḥ śakyam tvayā yatsukhamedhitum ॥2-52-36॥

translations.english: Princeregency is awaiting you because of our father's loving desire. See that through you (your actions) he is able to attain happiness in both the worlds.

verses.sloka: निवर्त्यमानो रामेण सुमन्त्रः शोक कर्शितः ।तत् सर्वम् वचनम् श्रुत्वा स्नेहात् काकुत्स्थम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-३७॥
verses.transliteration: nivartyamāno rāmeṇa sumantraḥ śoka karśitaḥ ।tat sarvam vacanam śrutvā snehāt kākutstham abravīt ॥2-52-37॥

translations.english: When Sumantra was asked by Rama to go back, he grew griefstricken. Having heard all that was said by the scion of the Kakutsthas, he replied:

verses.sloka: यद् अहम् न उपचारेण ब्रूयाम् स्नेहात् अविक्लवः ।भक्तिमान् इति तत् तावद् वाक्यम् त्वम् क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥२-५२-३८॥
verses.transliteration: yad aham na upacāreṇa brūyām snehāt aviklavaḥ ।bhaktimān iti tat tāvad vākyam tvam kṣantum arhasi ॥2-52-38॥

translations.english: I beg your pardon for what I have told you out of love. Accept it as the words of a devotee expressed without fear or formality.

verses.sloka: कथम् हि त्वद् विहीनो अहम् प्रतियास्यामि ताम् पुरीम् ।तव तात वियोगेन पुत्र शोक आकुलाम् इव ॥२-५२-३९॥
verses.transliteration: katham hi tvad vihīno aham pratiyāsyāmi tām purīm ।tava tāta viyogena putra śoka ākulām iva ॥2-52-39॥

translations.english: Without you how can I go back to the city (of Ayodhya) which, separated from you, is grieving like a lady who has lost her son?

verses.sloka: सरामम् अपि तावन् मे रथम् दृष्ट्वा तदा जनः ।विना रामम् रथम् दृष्ट्वा विदीर्येत अपि सा पुरी ॥२-५२-४०॥
verses.transliteration: sarāmam api tāvan me ratham dṛṣṭvā tadā janaḥ ।vinā rāmam ratham dṛṣṭvā vidīryeta api sā purī ॥2-52-40॥

translations.english: The people who had seen Rama board the chariot will be brokenhearted to see it without him.

verses.sloka: दैन्यम् हि नगरी गच्चेद् दृष्ट्वा शून्यम् इमम् रथम् ।सूत अवशेषम् स्वम् सैन्यम् हत वीरम् इव आहवे ॥२-५२-४१॥
verses.transliteration: dainyam hi nagarī gacced dṛṣṭvā śūnyam imam ratham ।sūta avaśeṣam svam sainyam hata vīram iva āhave ॥2-52-41॥

translations.english: Seeing the empty chariot the people of the city will look pitiable just like an army left only with the charioteer after its hero is killed in the war.

verses.sloka: दूरे अपि निवसन्तम् त्वाम् मानसेन अग्रतः स्थितम् ।चिन्तयन्त्यो अद्य नूनम् त्वाम् निराहाराः कृताः प्रजाः ॥२-५२-४२॥
verses.transliteration: dūre api nivasantam tvām mānasena agrataḥ sthitam ।cintayantyo adya nūnam tvām nirāhārāḥ kṛtāḥ prajāḥ ॥2-52-42॥

translations.english: Although living at a distance, the subjects feel in their minds that you are just ahead of them. Today they will certainly go without food, brooding over you.

verses.sloka: दृष्टं तद्धि त्वया राम! यादृशम् त्वत्प्रवासने ।प्रजानाम् सम्कुलम् वृत्तम् त्वच्छोकक्लान्तचेतसाम् ॥२-५२-४३॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaṁ taddhi tvayā rāma! yādṛśam tvatpravāsane ।prajānām samkulam vṛttam tvacchokaklāntacetasām ॥2-52-43॥

translations.english: At the time of your departure, O Rama, you have seen all that happened, the hearts of the people exhausted with grief.

verses.sloka: आर्त नादो हि यः पौरैः मुक्तः तत् विप्रवासने ।रथस्थम् माम् निशाम्य एव कुर्युः शत गुणम् ततः ॥२-५२-४४॥
verses.transliteration: ārta nādo hi yaḥ pauraiḥ muktaḥ tat vipravāsane ।rathastham mām niśāmya eva kuryuḥ śata guṇam tataḥ ॥2-52-44॥

translations.english: You have witnessed the cry of agony raised by the citizens at the time of your banishment. Now when they see the (empty) chariot, they will make it (raise their cry) a hundredfold.

verses.sloka: अहम् किम् च अपि वक्ष्यामि देवीम् तव सुतः मया ।नीतः असौ मातुल कुलम् सम्तापम् मा कृथाइति ॥२-५२-४५॥
verses.transliteration: aham kim ca api vakṣyāmi devīm tava sutaḥ mayā ।nītaḥ asau mātula kulam samtāpam mā kṛthāiti ॥2-52-45॥

translations.english: What shall I say to Kausalya? Shall I say 'O venerable queen I have left your son at his maternal uncle's, hence don't grieve'.

verses.sloka: असत्यम् अपि न एव अहम् ब्रूयाम् वचनम् ईदृशम् ।कथम् अप्रियम् एव अहम् ब्रूयाम् सत्यम् इदम् वचः ॥२-५२-४६॥
verses.transliteration: asatyam api na eva aham brūyām vacanam īdṛśam ।katham apriyam eva aham brūyām satyam idam vacaḥ ॥2-52-46॥

translations.english: How can I lie to her? How can I tell her the unpleasent truth?

verses.sloka: मम तावन् नियोगस्थाः त्वद् बन्धु जन वाहिनः ।कथम् रथम् त्वया हीनम् प्रवक्ष्यन्ति हय उत्तमाः ॥२-५२-४७॥
verses.transliteration: mama tāvan niyogasthāḥ tvad bandhu jana vāhinaḥ ।katham ratham tvayā hīnam pravakṣyanti haya uttamāḥ ॥2-52-47॥

translations.english: How can these excellent horses who used to carry you and your friends till now draw this chariot without you even though they are at my command?

verses.sloka: तन्न शक्ष्याम्यहम् गन्तुमयोध्याम् त्वदृतेऽनघ ।वनवासानुयानाय मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥२-५२-४८॥
verses.transliteration: tanna śakṣyāmyaham gantumayodhyām tvadṛte'nagha ।vanavāsānuyānāya māmanujñātumarhasi ॥2-52-48॥

translations.english: That is why, O sinless one I cannot go back to Ayodhya without you. Allow me to accompany you into your exile.

verses.sloka: यदि मे याचमानस्य त्यागम् एव करिष्यसि ।सरथो अग्निम् प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्यक्त मात्रैह त्वया ॥२-५२-४९॥
verses.transliteration: yadi me yācamānasya tyāgam eva kariṣyasi ।saratho agnim pravekṣyāmi tyakta mātraiha tvayā ॥2-52-49॥

translations.english: If you forsake me in spite of my request I shall immediately enter fire along with my chariot.

verses.sloka: भविष्यन्ति वने यानि तपो विघ्न कराणि ते ।रथेन प्रतिबाधिष्ये तानि सत्त्वानि राघव ॥२-५२-५०॥
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyanti vane yāni tapo vighna karāṇi te ।rathena pratibādhiṣye tāni sattvāni rāghava ॥2-52-50॥

translations.english: With my chariot I shall retaliate and prevent all those animals in the forest causing obstacles to your austerities, O Rama

verses.sloka: तत् कृतेन मया प्राप्तम् रथ चर्या कृतम् सुखम् ।आशम्से त्वत् कृतेन अहम् वन वास कृतम् सुखम् ॥२-५२-५१॥
verses.transliteration: tat kṛtena mayā prāptam ratha caryā kṛtam sukham ।āśamse tvat kṛtena aham vana vāsa kṛtam sukham ॥2-52-51॥

translations.english: By your grace I experienced the pleasure of driving your chariot, and by your grace, too, I am looking forward to deriving the pleasure of dwelling in the forest.

verses.sloka: प्रसीद इच्चामि ते अरण्ये भवितुम् प्रत्यनन्तरः ।प्रीत्या अभिहितम् इच्चामि भव मे पत्यनन्तरः ॥२-५२-५२॥
verses.transliteration: prasīda iccāmi te araṇye bhavitum pratyanantaraḥ ।prītyā abhihitam iccāmi bhava me patyanantaraḥ ॥2-52-52॥

translations.english: Be pleased. I wish to stay with you in the forest I long to hear from you these favourable words, 'Stay with me'.

verses.sloka: इमे चापि हया वीर यदि ते वनवासिनः ।परिचर्याम् करिष्यन्ति प्राप्स्यन्ति परमाम् गतिम् ॥२-५२-५३॥
verses.transliteration: ime cāpi hayā vīra yadi te vanavāsinaḥ ।paricaryām kariṣyanti prāpsyanti paramām gatim ॥2-52-53॥

translations.english: O valiant one, if these horses too could render services to you while you dwell in the forest, they would attain the supreme state.

verses.sloka: तव शुश्रूषणम् मूर्ध्ना करिष्यामि वने वसन् ।अयोध्याम् देव लोकम् वा सर्वथा प्रजहाम्य् अहम् ॥२-५२-५४॥
verses.transliteration: tava śuśrūṣaṇam mūrdhnā kariṣyāmi vane vasan ।ayodhyām deva lokam vā sarvathā prajahāmy aham ॥2-52-54॥

translations.english: As I dwell in the forest, I shall serve you with my head bowed. For this I may altogether relinquish Ayodhya or even heaven.

verses.sloka: न हि शक्या प्रवेष्टुम् सा मया अयोध्या त्वया विना ।राज धानी महा इन्द्रस्य यथा दुष्कृत कर्मणा ॥२-५२-५५॥
verses.transliteration: na hi śakyā praveṣṭum sā mayā ayodhyā tvayā vinā ।rāja dhānī mahā indrasya yathā duṣkṛta karmaṇā ॥2-52-55॥

translations.english: Just as a sinner cannot enter the capital of Indra (heaven), it is impossible for me to enter Ayodhya without you.

verses.sloka: वन वासे क्षयम् प्राप्ते मम एष हि मनो रथः ।यद् अनेन रथेन एव त्वाम् वहेयम् पुरीम् पुनः ॥२-५२-५६॥
verses.transliteration: vana vāse kṣayam prāpte mama eṣa hi mano rathaḥ ।yad anena rathena eva tvām vaheyam purīm punaḥ ॥2-52-56॥

translations.english: It is my cherished desire to take you after the completion of your exile, back to the city (Ayodhya) in this chariot alone.

verses.sloka: चतुर् दश हि वर्षाणि सहितस्य त्वया वने ।क्षण भूतानि यास्यन्ति शतशः तु ततः अन्यथा ॥२-५२-५७॥
verses.transliteration: catur daśa hi varṣāṇi sahitasya tvayā vane ।kṣaṇa bhūtāni yāsyanti śataśaḥ tu tataḥ anyathā ॥2-52-57॥

translations.english: If I accompany you into the forest, fourteen years will pass like a moment, otherwise it will seem like a hundred years.

verses.sloka: भृत्य वत्सल तिष्ठन्तम् भर्तृ पुत्र गते पथि ।भक्तम् भृत्यम् स्थितम् स्थित्याम् त्वम् न माम् हातुम् अर्हसि ॥२-५२-५८॥
verses.transliteration: bhṛtya vatsala tiṣṭhantam bhartṛ putra gate pathi ।bhaktam bhṛtyam sthitam sthityām tvam na mām hātum arhasi ॥2-52-58॥

translations.english: O Rama you are affectionate towards your servants. I abide in the path followed by you, my master's son. I am your devoted servant. It does not behove you to forsake me who is faithful.

verses.sloka: एवम् बहु विधम् दीनम् याचमानम् पुनः पुनः ।रामः भृत्य अनुकम्पी तु सुमन्त्रम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-५९॥
verses.transliteration: evam bahu vidham dīnam yācamānam punaḥ punaḥ ।rāmaḥ bhṛtya anukampī tu sumantram idam abravīt ॥2-52-59॥

translations.english: Repeatedly implored in various ways by the miserable Sumantra, Rama who is compassionate to his servants replied:

verses.sloka: जानामि परमाम् भक्तिम् मयि ते भर्तृ वत्सल ।शृणु च अपि यद् अर्थम् त्वाम् प्रेषयामि पुरीम् इतः ॥२-५२-६०॥
verses.transliteration: jānāmi paramām bhaktim mayi te bhartṛ vatsala ।śṛṇu ca api yad artham tvām preṣayāmi purīm itaḥ ॥2-52-60॥

translations.english: O Sumantra, listen I know your deep devotion to me (I also know) you are loyal to your master (Dasaratha). So I am sending you to the city (Ayodhya) from here.

verses.sloka: नगरीम् त्वाम् गतम् दृष्ट्वा जननी मे यवीयसी ।कैकेयी प्रत्ययम् गच्चेद् इति रामः वनम् गतः ॥२-५२-६१॥
verses.transliteration: nagarīm tvām gatam dṛṣṭvā jananī me yavīyasī ।kaikeyī pratyayam gacced iti rāmaḥ vanam gataḥ ॥2-52-61॥

translations.english: When my younger mother Kaikeyi sees that you have returned to Ayodhya, she will believe that Rama has really gone to the forest.

verses.sloka: परितुष्टा हि सा देवि वन वासम् गते मयि ।राजानम् न अतिशन्केत मिथ्या वादी इति धार्मिकम् ॥२-५२-६२॥
verses.transliteration: parituṣṭā hi sā devi vana vāsam gate mayi ।rājānam na atiśanketa mithyā vādī iti dhārmikam ॥2-52-62॥

translations.english: If queen Kaikeyi is fully satisfied that I have gone to dwell in the forest, she will no longer have any doubt and will believe that righteous king Dasaratha is not a liar.

verses.sloka: एष मे प्रथमः कल्पो यद् अम्बा मे यवीयसी ।भरत आरक्षितम् स्फीतम् पुत्र राज्यम् अवाप्नुयात् ॥२-५२-६३॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa me prathamaḥ kalpo yad ambā me yavīyasī ।bharata ārakṣitam sphītam putra rājyam avāpnuyāt ॥2-52-63॥

translations.english: My prime resolve is that my younger mother should enjoy this prosperous and vast kingdom ruled by her son Bharata.

verses.sloka: मम प्रिय अर्थम् राज्ञः च सरथः त्वम् पुरीम् व्रज ।सम्दिष्टः च असि या अनर्थाम्स् ताम्स् तान् ब्रूयाः तथा तथा ॥२-५२-६४॥
verses.transliteration: mama priya artham rājñaḥ ca sarathaḥ tvam purīm vraja ।samdiṣṭaḥ ca asi yā anarthāms tāms tān brūyāḥ tathā tathā ॥2-52-64॥

translations.english: Sumantra, return to the city with the chariot for my pleasure and also for the pleasure of the king and convey to each of the persons concerned the message exactly as instructed.

verses.sloka: इति उक्त्वा वचनम् सूतम् सान्त्वयित्वा पुनः पुनः ।गुहम् वचनम् अक्लीबम् रामः हेतुमद् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-६५॥
verses.transliteration: iti uktvā vacanam sūtam sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।guham vacanam aklībam rāmaḥ hetumad abravīt ॥2-52-65॥

translations.english: Having spoken to the charioteer and consoling him again and again, indefatigable Rama spoke to Guha words full of reasoning:

verses.sloka: नेदानीम् गुह योग्योऽयम् वसो मे सजने वने ।अवश्यम् ह्याश्रमे वासह् कर्तव्यस्तद्गतो विधिः ॥२-५२-६६॥
verses.transliteration: nedānīm guha yogyo'yam vaso me sajane vane ।avaśyam hyāśrame vāsah kartavyastadgato vidhiḥ ॥2-52-66॥

translations.english: Guha this forest where people live is not suitable for my stay. It is necessary that I live in a hermitage. So please do the needful.

verses.sloka: सोऽहम् गृहीत्वा नियमम् तपस्विजनभूषणम् ।हितकामः पितुर्भूयः सीताया लक्ष्मणस्य च ॥२-५२-६७॥
verses.transliteration: so'ham gṛhītvā niyamam tapasvijanabhūṣaṇam ।hitakāmaḥ piturbhūyaḥ sītāyā lakṣmaṇasya ca ॥2-52-67॥

translations.english: Seeking the welfare of my father, Sita and Lakshmana I shall enter the forest with matted hair and practise the prescribed austerities which are the adornments of ascetics. Do fetch me the sap of a banyan tree.

verses.sloka: जटाः कृत्वा गमिष्यामि न्यग्रोध क्षीरम् आनय ।तत् क्षीरम् राज पुत्राय गुहः क्षिप्रम् उपाहरत् ॥२-५२-६८॥
verses.transliteration: jaṭāḥ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi nyagrodha kṣīram ānaya ।tat kṣīram rāja putrāya guhaḥ kṣipram upāharat ॥2-52-68॥

translations.english: Guha fetched the latex quickly and gave it to the prince (Rama) and with that Rama matted his own hair and Lakshmana's.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य आत्मनः चैव रामः तेन अकरोज् जटाः ।दीर्घबाहुर्नरव्याघ्रो जटिलत्व मधारयत् ॥२-५२-६९॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya ātmanaḥ caiva rāmaḥ tena akaroj jaṭāḥ ।dīrghabāhurnaravyāghro jaṭilatva madhārayat ॥2-52-69॥

translations.english: The longarmed Rama, the best of men, put on locks of matted hair. As the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana stood dressed in bark wearing crowns of matted hair, they resembled two resplendent ascetics.

verses.sloka: तौ तदा चीर वसनौ जटा मण्डल धारिणौ ।अशोभेताम् ऋषि समौ भ्रातरौ राम रक्ष्मणौ ॥२-५२-७०॥
verses.transliteration: tau tadā cīra vasanau jaṭā maṇḍala dhāriṇau ।aśobhetām ṛṣi samau bhrātarau rāma rakṣmaṇau ॥2-52-70॥

translations.english: The longarmed Rama, the best of men, put on locks of matted hair. As the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana stood dressed in bark wearing crowns of matted hair, they resembled two resplendent ascetics.

verses.sloka: ततः वैखानसम् मार्गम् आस्थितः सह लक्ष्मणः ।व्रतम् आदिष्टवान् रामः सहायम् गुहम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-७१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ vaikhānasam mārgam āsthitaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।vratam ādiṣṭavān rāmaḥ sahāyam guham abravīt ॥2-52-71॥

translations.english: Having adopted the path of ascetics along with Lakshmana, Rama said to his friend Guha:

verses.sloka: अप्रमत्तः बले कोशे दुर्गे जन पदे तथा ।भवेथा गुह राज्यम् हि दुरारक्षतमम् मतम् ॥२-५२-७२॥
verses.transliteration: apramattaḥ bale kośe durge jana pade tathā ।bhavethā guha rājyam hi durārakṣatamam matam ॥2-52-72॥

translations.english: O Guha you must be vigilant about your army, treasury, forts and provinces. A kingdom, it is (rightly) said, is protected with great difficulty.

verses.sloka: ततः तम् समनुज्ञाय गुहम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनः ।जगाम तूर्णम् अव्यग्रः सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः ॥२-५२-७३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tam samanujñāya guham ikṣvāku nandanaḥ ।jagāma tūrṇam avyagraḥ sabhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥2-52-73॥

translations.english: Rama, Delight of the Iksvakus, then permitted Guha to take leave. And departed quickly with his consort and Lakshmana in peace.

verses.sloka: स तु दृष्ट्वा नदी तीरे नावम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनः ।तितीर्षुः शीघ्रगाम् गन्गाम् इदम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-७४॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu dṛṣṭvā nadī tīre nāvam ikṣvāku nandanaḥ ।titīrṣuḥ śīghragām gangām idam lakṣmaṇam abravīt ॥2-52-74॥

translations.english: Seeing the boat on the river bank and intending to cross the swiftly flowing Ganga, Rama, descendant of the Iksvakus said to Lakshmana:

verses.sloka: आरोह त्वम् नर व्याघ्र स्थिताम् नावम् इमाम् शनैः ।सीताम् च आरोपय अन्वक्षम् परिगृह्य मनस्विनीम् ॥२-५२-७५॥
verses.transliteration: āroha tvam nara vyāghra sthitām nāvam imām śanaiḥ ।sītām ca āropaya anvakṣam parigṛhya manasvinīm ॥2-52-75॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, the best of men the boat stands ready, get into it slowly (carefully), and then help the noble Sita board it by holding the beam (which balances the boat).

verses.sloka: स भ्रातुः शासनम् श्रुत्वा सर्वम् अप्रतिकूलयन् ।आरोप्य मैथिलीम् पूर्वम् आरुरोह आत्मवाम्स् ततः ॥२-५२-७६॥
verses.transliteration: sa bhrātuḥ śāsanam śrutvā sarvam apratikūlayan ।āropya maithilīm pūrvam āruroha ātmavāms tataḥ ॥2-52-76॥

translations.english: Having heard his brother's command the selfcontrolled Lakshmana did as he was told.He first helped Sita get into the boat and thereafter boarded it himself.

verses.sloka: अथ आरुरोह तेजस्वी स्वयम् लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः ।ततः निषाद अधिपतिर् गुहो ज्ञातीन् अचोदयत् ॥२-५२-७७॥
verses.transliteration: atha āruroha tejasvī svayam lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ ।tataḥ niṣāda adhipatir guho jñātīn acodayat ॥2-52-77॥

translations.english: With the boat boarded by the glorious Rama, Lakshmana's elder brother, Guha, king of the nishadas urged his kinsmen (to row the boat).

verses.sloka: राघवोऽपि महातेजा नावमारुह्य ताम् ततः ।ब्रह्मवत् क्षत्रवच्चैव जजाप हितमात्मनः ॥२-५२-७८॥
verses.transliteration: rāghavo'pi mahātejā nāvamāruhya tām tataḥ ।brahmavat kṣatravaccaiva jajāpa hitamātmanaḥ ॥2-52-78॥

translations.english: Resplendent Rama boarded the boat and muttered for his own safety mantras befitting brahmins and kshatriyas.

verses.sloka: आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रम् नदीम् ताम् सह सीतया ।प्राणमत्प्रीतिसम्हृष्टो लक्ष्मणश्चामितप्रभः ॥२-५२-७९॥
verses.transliteration: ācamya ca yathāśāstram nadīm tām saha sītayā ।prāṇamatprītisamhṛṣṭo lakṣmaṇaścāmitaprabhaḥ ॥2-52-79॥

translations.english: Rama of undimmed radiance sipped the waters (of the Ganga) in accordance with the scriptures and with great pleasure and paid obeisance to the river with Sita and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: अनुज्ञाय सुमन्त्रम् च सबलम् चैव तम् गुहम् ।आस्थाय नावम् रामः तु चोदयाम् आस नाविकान् ॥२-५२-८०॥
verses.transliteration: anujñāya sumantram ca sabalam caiva tam guham ।āsthāya nāvam rāmaḥ tu codayām āsa nāvikān ॥2-52-80॥

translations.english: Having permitted Sumantra and Guha with his army to leave, Rama seated on the boat urged the boatmen to proceed.

verses.sloka: ततः तैः चोदिता सा नौः कर्ण धार समाहिता ।शुभ स्फ्य वेग अभिहता शीघ्रम् सलिलम् अत्यगात् ॥२-५२-८१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ taiḥ coditā sā nauḥ karṇa dhāra samāhitā ।śubha sphya vega abhihatā śīghram salilam atyagāt ॥2-52-81॥

translations.english: The wellruddered boat rowed by the helmsmen and propelled by strong oars, swiftly crossed the waters of the river.

verses.sloka: मध्यम् तु समनुप्राप्य भागीरथ्याः तु अनिन्दिता ।वैदेही प्रान्जलिर् भूत्वा ताम् नदीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५२-८२॥
verses.transliteration: madhyam tu samanuprāpya bhāgīrathyāḥ tu aninditā ।vaidehī prānjalir bhūtvā tām nadīm idam abravīt ॥2-52-82॥

translations.english: When the boat reached the midstream that unblemished Sita with palms folded invoked the river thus:

verses.sloka: पुत्रः दशरथस्य अयम् महा राजस्य धीमतः ।निदेशम् पालयतु एनम् गन्गे त्वद् अभिरक्षितः ॥२-५२-८३॥
verses.transliteration: putraḥ daśarathasya ayam mahā rājasya dhīmataḥ ।nideśam pālayatu enam gange tvad abhirakṣitaḥ ॥2-52-83॥

translations.english: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.

verses.sloka: चतुर् दश हि वर्षाणि समग्राणि उष्य कानने ।भ्रात्रा सह मया चैव पुनः प्रत्यागमिष्यति ॥२-५२-८४॥
verses.transliteration: catur daśa hi varṣāṇi samagrāṇi uṣya kānane ।bhrātrā saha mayā caiva punaḥ pratyāgamiṣyati ॥2-52-84॥

translations.english: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.

verses.sloka: ततः त्वाम् देवि सुभगे क्षेमेण पुनर् आगता ।यक्ष्ये प्रमुदिता गन्गे सर्व काम समृद्धये ॥२-५२-८५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tvām devi subhage kṣemeṇa punar āgatā ।yakṣye pramuditā gange sarva kāma samṛddhaye ॥2-52-85॥

translations.english: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.

verses.sloka: त्वम् हि त्रिपथगा देवि ब्रह्म लोकम् समीक्षसे ।भार्या च उदधि राजस्य लोके अस्मिन् सम्प्रदृश्यसे ॥२-५२-८६॥
verses.transliteration: tvam hi tripathagā devi brahma lokam samīkṣase ।bhāryā ca udadhi rājasya loke asmin sampradṛśyase ॥2-52-86॥

translations.english: O Devi, you are Tripathaga, flowing in three directions (worlds). You behold the region of Brahma and happen to be the spouse of the king of the ocean in this world (of mortals).

verses.sloka: सा त्वाम् देवि नमस्यामि प्रशम्सामि च शोभने ।प्राप्त राज्ये नर व्याघ्र शिवेन पुनर् आगते ॥२-५२-८७॥
verses.transliteration: sā tvām devi namasyāmi praśamsāmi ca śobhane ।prāpta rājye nara vyāghra śivena punar āgate ॥2-52-87॥

translations.english: O Devi O lovely Ganga I offer you my obeisance and my adorations. After the safe return of Rama, the tiger (best) among men, from the forest and after he regains the kingdom I shall give a hundred thousand cows, clothing and delicious food to brahmins as a mark of regard, which will please you.

verses.sloka: गवाम् शत सहस्राणि वस्त्राणि अन्नम् च पेशलम् ।ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदास्यामि तव प्रिय चिकीर्षया ॥२-५२-८८॥
verses.transliteration: gavām śata sahasrāṇi vastrāṇi annam ca peśalam ।brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyāmi tava priya cikīrṣayā ॥2-52-88॥

translations.english: O Devi O lovely Ganga I offer you my obeisance and my adorations. After the safe return of Rama, the tiger (best) among men, from the forest and after he regains the kingdom I shall give a hundred thousand cows, clothing and delicious food to brahmins as a mark of regard, which will please you.

verses.sloka: सुराघटसहस्रेण माम्सभूतोदनेन च ।यक्ष्ये त्वाम् प्रयता देवि पुरीम् पुनरुपागता ॥२-५२-८९॥
verses.transliteration: surāghaṭasahasreṇa māmsabhūtodanena ca ।yakṣye tvām prayatā devi purīm punarupāgatā ॥2-52-89॥

translations.english: O Devi after my return to Ayodhya purified by my austerities, I shall worship you by offering a thousand pots of nectar and food in the form of meat.

verses.sloka: यानि त्वत्तीरवासीनि दैवतानि च सन्ति हि ।तानि सर्वाणि यक्ष्यामि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ॥२-५२-९०॥
verses.transliteration: yāni tvattīravāsīni daivatāni ca santi hi ।tāni sarvāṇi yakṣyāmi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ॥2-52-90॥

translations.english: I shall worship all those deities inhabiting your banks and all sacred spots and temples.

verses.sloka: पुनरेव महाबाउर्मया भ्रात्रा च सम्गतः ।अयोध्याम् वनवासात्तु प्रविशत्वनघोऽनघे ॥२-५२-९१॥
verses.transliteration: punareva mahābāurmayā bhrātrā ca samgataḥ ।ayodhyām vanavāsāttu praviśatvanagho'naghe ॥2-52-91॥

translations.english: O sacred one may the blemishless, mightyarmed Rama accompanied by me and his brother reenter Ayodhya after the exile.

verses.sloka: तथा सम्भाषमाणा सा सीता गन्गाम् अनिन्दिता ।दक्षिणा दक्षिणम् तीरम् क्षिप्रम् एव अभ्युपागमत् ॥२-५२-९२॥
verses.transliteration: tathā sambhāṣamāṇā sā sītā gangām aninditā ।dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇam tīram kṣipram eva abhyupāgamat ॥2-52-92॥

translations.english: While the unblemished, auspicious Sita was thus addressing (the river), the boat swiftly reached the south bank.

verses.sloka: तीरम् तु समनुप्राप्य नावम् हित्वा नर ऋषभः ।प्रातिष्ठत सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च परम् तपः ॥२-५२-९३॥
verses.transliteration: tīram tu samanuprāpya nāvam hitvā nara ṛṣabhaḥ ।prātiṣṭhata saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca param tapaḥ ॥2-52-93॥

translations.english: Rama, the best of men and tormentor of enemies, after reaching the other side of the river, left the boat and proceeded with Sita and his brother.

verses.sloka: अथ अब्रवीन् महा बाहुः सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनम् ।भव सम्रक्षणार्थाय सजने विजनेऽपि वा ॥२-५२-९४॥
verses.transliteration: atha abravīn mahā bāhuḥ sumitra ānanda vardhanam ।bhava samrakṣaṇārthāya sajane vijane'pi vā ॥2-52-94॥

translations.english: The longarmed Rama then said to Lakshmana, enhancer of the joy of Sumitra: Whether in populated areas or in solitary places, excercise alacrity in the matter of protection.

verses.sloka: अवश्यम् रक्षणम् कार्यमदृष्टे विजने वने ।अग्रतः गच्च सौमित्रे सीता त्वाम् अनुगच्चतु ॥२-५२-९५॥
verses.transliteration: avaśyam rakṣaṇam kāryamadṛṣṭe vijane vane ।agrataḥ gacca saumitre sītā tvām anugaccatu ॥2-52-95॥

translations.english: In this desolate forest which we had never seen before we must certainly be concerned about our protection. O Lakshmana , let Sita follow you

verses.sloka: पृष्ठतः अहम् गमिष्यामि त्वाम् च सीताम् च पालयन् ।अद्य दुह्खम् तु वैदेही वन वासस्य वेत्स्यति ॥२-५२-९६॥
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhataḥ aham gamiṣyāmi tvām ca sītām ca pālayan ।adya duhkham tu vaidehī vana vāsasya vetsyati ॥2-52-96॥

translations.english: O best of men, I will follow you and Sita and keep watch. We must ensure mutual protection.

verses.sloka: न हि तावदतिक्रान्ता सुकरा काचन क्रिया ।अद्य दुःखम् तु वैदेही वनवासस्य वेत्स्यति ॥२-५२-९७॥
verses.transliteration: na hi tāvadatikrāntā sukarā kācana kriyā ।adya duḥkham tu vaidehī vanavāsasya vetsyati ॥2-52-97॥

translations.english: We have not yet confronted any hardship. From now on Sita will come to know the difficulties of forest life.

verses.sloka: प्रणष्टजनसम्बाधम् क्षेत्रारामविवर्बितम् ।विषमम् च प्रपातम् च वनमद्य प्रवेक्ष्यति ॥२-५२-९८॥
verses.transliteration: praṇaṣṭajanasambādham kṣetrārāmavivarbitam ।viṣamam ca prapātam ca vanamadya pravekṣyati ॥2-52-98॥

translations.english: Now she will enter the forest which is devoid of concourse of people, farms and pleasure groves and which is uneven and inaccessible and full of deep ditches.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनम् प्रतिस्थे लक्ष्मण्Oऽग्रतः ।अनन्तरम् च सीताया राघवो रघनन्धनः ॥२-५२-९९॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā rāmasya vacanam pratisthe lakṣmaṇO'grataḥ ।anantaram ca sītāyā rāghavo raghanandhanaḥ ॥2-52-99॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Rama, Lakshmana went ahead and Rama, delight of the Raghus, walked behind Sita.

verses.sloka: गतम् तु गन्गा पर पारम् आशु ।रामम् सुमन्त्रः प्रततम् निरीक्ष्य ।अध्व प्रकर्षात् विनिवृत्त दृष्टिर् ।र्मुमोच बाष्पम् व्यथितः तपस्वी ॥२-५२-१००॥
verses.transliteration: gatam tu gangā para pāram āśu ।rāmam sumantraḥ pratatam nirīkṣya ।adhva prakarṣāt vinivṛtta dṛṣṭir ।rmumoca bāṣpam vyathitaḥ tapasvī ॥2-52-100॥

translations.english: The wretched Sumantra kept gazing at Rama who swiftly reached the other side of the Ganga and only when he could not see him because of long distance, he turned away his gaze and, overcome with grief, shed tears.

verses.sloka: स लोकपालप्रतिमप्रभाववाम् ।स्तीर्त्वा महात्मा वरदो महानदीम् ।ततः समृद्धान् शुभसस्यमालिनः ।क्रमेण वत्सान् मुदितानुपागमत् ॥२-५२-१०१॥
verses.transliteration: sa lokapālapratimaprabhāvavām ।stīrtvā mahātmā varado mahānadīm ।tataḥ samṛddhān śubhasasyamālinaḥ ।krameṇa vatsān muditānupāgamat ॥2-52-101॥

translations.english: Having crossed that mighty river, the highsouled Rama, bestower of boons and equal in splendour, to the Protector of the world reached Vatsa by and by, a highly prosperous country inhabited by happy people.

verses.sloka: तौ तत्र हत्वा चतुरः महा मृगान् ।वराहम् ऋश्यम् पृषतम् महा रुरुम् ।आदाय मेध्यम् त्वरितम् बुभुक्षितौ।वासाय काले ययतुर् वनः पतिम् ॥२-५२-१०२॥
verses.transliteration: tau tatra hatvā caturaḥ mahā mṛgān ।varāham ṛśyam pṛṣatam mahā rurum ।ādāya medhyam tvaritam bubhukṣitau।vāsāya kāle yayatur vanaḥ patim ॥2-52-102॥

translations.english: Famished, they (Rama and Lakshmana) killed a boar, a rishya (whitefooted male antelope), a spotted deer and a great deer with black stripes. They partook the meat and reached a tree by evening where they rested for the night. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्विपञ्चाश स्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
